name: deployctl
description: Command line tool for Deno Deploy

subcommands.name: deploy
subcommands.description: Deploy a script with static files to Deno Deploy

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Exclude files that match this pattern

options.name: --include
options.description: Only upload files that match this pattern

options.name: --no-static
options.description: Don't include the files in the CWD as static files

options.name: --prod
options.description: Create a production deployment (default is preview deployment)
